units: <cite ref="Pesachim 10b:4">Pes. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>דרכו של תינוק לפָרֵר</he> it is a child’s way to crumble bread (and leave it on the ground).
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 2:1">Ib. II, 1</cite> <he>מְפָרֵר וזורה וכ׳</he> he may crumble (the leavened bread) and cast it to the wind; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 6:29">Tosef. Shebi. VI, 29</cite> <he>מְפָרְרִין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q02017"><he>פָּרַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:11">Ab. III, 11</cite> <he>המֵפֵר בריתו וכ׳</he> he that breaks the Abrahamitic covenant (omits or effaces circumcision, v. <cite ref="M02892"><he>מָשַׁךְ</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (play on <cite ref="Q02043"><he>פֹּרָת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:22">Gen. XLIX, 22</cite>) <he>בן שה׳ לאחיו</he> the son that broke (faith) with his brothers; <cite ref="Genesis 49:22">ib.</cite> <he>שהֵפֵירוּ לו אחיו</he> to whom his brothers were faithless; <cite ref="Genesis 49:22">ib.</cite> <he>שה׳ לאדונתו</he>, v. <cite ref="A00386"><he>אֲדוֹנָה</he></cite>.

Gen. R. s. 16 (play on פְּרָת, Gen. II, 14) פרת שהֵפֵירָה והצירה לבניו Edom (Rome) is called P’rath, because she broke faith with, and distressed his (God’s) children (Var. לפניו); שאני עתיד להָפֵר לה because I (the Lord) shall in the end thwart her plans; Yalk. ib. 22; a. fr.—Esp. to make void; to disallow a vow (Num. XXX, 2-16).

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 10:1">Ned. X, 1</cite> <he>אביה ובעלה מְפִירִין וכ׳</he> both her father and her husband must declare her vow void; <he>ה׳ האב וכ׳</he> if only the father protested, and the husband did not. Ib. 2 <he>הבעל מֵפֵר בבגר וכ׳</he> in the case of an adult the husband has the right of disallowing, but not the father. Ib. 4 <he>אינו יכול להָפֵר</he> he has no power to disallow her vows. Ib. 5 <he>יָפֵר</he> he has the power &c. Ib. 72ᵃ, a. e. <he>אין הבעל מֵיפֵר בקודמין</he> the husband cannot invalidate vows made before marriage. Ib. XI, 12 (90ᵇ) <he>יָפֵר</he> (<cite ref="L00000"><he>ל</he></cite>)<he>חלקי</he> he may invalidate her vow for his share (as far as it concerns him). Ib. 7 <he>איני יודע שוש מפירין</he> I did not know that there are invalidating powers (vested in the husband); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מוּפָר</he>; pl. <he>מוּפָרִין</he>. Ib. X, 1 <he>אינו מ׳</he> her vow is not made void. Ib. 4 <he>כל נדרים … הרי הן מ׳</he> whatever vows thou mayest have made in my house, shall be void. Ib. 77ᵇ <he>מ׳ ליכי</he> thy vow is void; a. fr.
